title: [VIC] Longi Solar 6.6kW Panel + 20kWh Sofar Battery Package from $8125 Installed @ Hytech Solar
body:
Deal: [VIC] Longi Solar 6.6kW Panel + 20kWh Sofar Battery Package from $8125 Installed @ Hytech Solar

[Lucille Bluth] Inverter: 5kW Single Phase
So sick of these sales reps trying to catch out unsuspecting/uneducated buyers by quoting prices with such small, completely impracticable inverters.
[Lucille Bluth] Your comment has nothing to do with what I said?
A solar battery with a 5kWh inverter is next to useless and it will struggle to fill the battery from PV generation alone most days, if not all when combined with the regular concurrent energy demands of your home.
[Aston Solar] You bring up a very valid point regarding concurrent energy demands. For a household with high daytime energy usage, a 5kW inverter can indeed become a bottleneck for battery charging.
However, for homes with low daytime usage, a 5kW inverter (which is typically oversized with up to 6.6kW of solar panels) generates more than enough excess power to run the house and fill the battery. This is exactly why we design systems based on your specific energy profile. If your daytime consumption is high, we will absolutely look at upgrading you to a larger inverter to ensure your battery charges efficiently.
[Wiadro] Sofar Battery
sounds as legit as all these deals
[Lizard Spock] "How's your new battery?"
"Sofar so good."
[Aston Solar] Comparatively new brand but getting good feedback from the customers
[Yamahar6] 6.6kwh Jinko solar with 10kwh Foxess inverter and 25kwh foxess battery getting installed tomorrow for $7,000. Victoria
[Aston Solar] That is a good deal!
However, I want to clarify that the $8,125 quote I shared is the base price before applying any government incentives.
If you are eligible for the Solar Victoria programs, your pricing breaks down like this:
Total System Price: $6,725 (after the $1,400 VIC rebate is applied).
Upfront Cost at Installation: $5,325 (if you also choose to utilize the $1,400 interest-free loan).
This means your out-of-pocket expense on the day of installation will only be $5,325.
